test_title: PYST 19: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 24 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: This can impact negatively on family bonds.
This can impact negatively on family baunds.
This can impaact negatively on family bonds.
This can impact negativly on family bonds.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"impact"** means to have a strong effect on something or someone. (प्रभाव डालना)

 
 
• **Example: **The new policy will significantly impact the company's operations.
 
 
 
• **"Bonds" **refers to the connections or relationships between people or groups. (बंधन)
 
 
• **Example: **Family bonds are crucial for emotional support and well-being.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: "baunds" **(बॉंड्स): This is an incorrect spelling of "bonds".

 
 
• **Example:** The word "baunds" does not exist in English.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: "impaact" **(इंपैक्ट): This is an incorrect spelling of "impact".
 
 
• **Example: **The word "impaact" does not exist in English.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: "negativly" **(निगेटिवली): This is an incorrect spelling of "negatively".
 
 
• **Example:** The word "negativly" does not exist in English.
